patterns.note: The site uses a dark, spacious layout with full-width sections, often featuring a central content block, but also incorporates asymmetrical and scattered elements (like speech bubbles and small images) in mid-page sections to break visual monotony.
Headings use a large, clean sans-serif font for impact, while body text is a highly readable, slightly lighter weight sans-serif. Small, uppercase labels are used for navigation and section titles.

A dominant dark background (#0e0e0e) with contrasting white text is used throughout, punctuated by subtle, vibrant accent colors (green, purple, yellow, blue) primarily for small interactive elements, social icons, and speech bubbles.

The header transforms and sticks to the top of the viewport upon scroll, consolidating its navigation links into a single dark pill and changing the 'Get in touch' button to a white pill with a dark border.

Client logos are presented in a dense, balanced grid, while feature cards (Digital Products, AI Workflows, Digital Strategy) are arranged in a three-column grid with subtle rounded corners and 'Learn more' links.

technique_notes: The header implements a sticky effect where its layout and styling dynamically change after a certain scroll threshold. Initially, navigation links are separate, and the CTA is a bordered button; upon scroll, they condense into a compact, pill-shaped navigation bar with a distinct pill-shaped CTA button, maintaining a consistent top position.

Content sections appear to scroll up statically, with no observed parallax or scroll-triggered fade-in animations for main content blocks. The design relies on the transforming sticky header for its primary motion interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, clean sans-serif hero heading (~3-4x body) with standard body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; buttons, cards, and speech bubbles feature noticeable but not extreme corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with some areas like client logos and feature cards having a more balanced, tighter grid.

standout: The site's distinctive use of scattered, 'chat-like' speech bubble elements and small, contextual images throughout the mid-page content creates a dynamic, almost collaborative or 'digital whiteboard' feel, moving beyond a typical static content layout. The transforming sticky header also adds a polished, interactive touch.
